response: The situation unfolding in Nigeria reveals the complete breakdown of social order when outfits like the All Progressives Congress ditch their obligations to the nation and morph into private clubs serving only the wealthy elite. Those recent internal moves ahead of the 2027 general elections lay this bare. It stems directly from abandoning traditional authority and national loyalty for nothing but raw elite self-interest. Unless there is a decisive return to personal responsibility, family values, and cultural continuity, everyday citizens will continue to be sidelined by those fixated solely on grabbing more power and money for themselves.
